auth.loginSubtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link — no password needed.
auth.magicLinkSentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a sign-in link is on its way. The link expires in 15 minutes.
auth.devModeHelp: POSTMARK_TOKEN is unset, so the API returned the magic-link token directly. Click the URL below to simulate the email click.
auth.verifyingBody: One moment while we verify your magic link.
auth.verifySuccess: Signed in. Taking you to the app…
auth.verifyInvalidToken: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.verifyMissingToken: No token found in the URL.

onboarding.title: Find your starting point
onboarding.subtitle: Three quick questions. We'll place you on the right rung of each skill tree.
onboarding.q1: Can you do a strict pull-up?
onboarding.q1Hint: Chin above the bar, controlled descent. One clean rep counts.
onboarding.q2Support: Can you hold a front-lever support for 15 seconds?
onboarding.q2SupportHint: Tucked or straight — body horizontal, arms straight, off the ground.
onboarding.q2Hang: Can you hold an active hang for 10 seconds?
onboarding.q2HangHint: Dead hang with engaged shoulders and lats. Not just hanging from your joints.
onboarding.testBody: Do push-ups at your normal pace. Stop when you feel you could do 2 more (RIR-2). Enter that count.
onboarding.testHint: Knee push-ups count if that's your current max — be honest, not aspirational.
onboarding.resultBody: Here's where you're starting on each tree. Unlocks progress as you log workouts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune the app for how and where you train.
settings.displayNameHint: 1–32 characters. Shown on your share cards.
settings.displayNameErrorTooLong: Display name must be 32 characters or fewer.
settings.iconOnlyControlsHint: These buttons are icon-only and labelled for screen readers via aria-label.
